header.name: mc-test-lib arity, expiry, handler-write and filter probes
header.description: Four questions the design carries as inference: whether a member called with more arguments than its declared maximum throws; where an effect's duration lands on the tick it expires; what the engine does with an out-of-range duration written by a beforeEvents.effectAdd handler; and whether subscribe options intersect or union, and which payload member they read. Run /scriptevent mctest8:arity, mctest8:expiry, mctest8:handlerwrite and mctest8:filters, and copy the [mctest] lines.
